title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-voln: transcript_2 lacks CBOR bstr encoding for EDHOC transcript hash
description: In rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs, the `transcript_2` function computes TH_2 as `SHA-256(G_Y_raw || H(message_1)_raw)` using raw byte concatenation. Per RFC 9528 Section 3.2 and verified by RFC 9529 Appendix C trace: TH_2 = H(CBOR_Sequence(G_Y, H(message_1))) where each element is individually CBOR-encoded as a bstr. The RFC 9529 trace shows the input as `bstr(G_Y) || bstr(H(message_1))` = 68 bytes, but the code produces 64 bytes (raw concatenation). This affects all downstream computations (KEYSTREAM_2 derivation, TH_3, TH_4, MAC_2 verification) because TH_2 feeds into all of them. Both initiator (line 794) and responder (line 1151) use the same non-compliant transcript_2. The EDHOC interop test in tests/vectors.rs only checks oscore_master_secret is non-empty, not actual computed values against the JSON oracle.
